reviews.x: This is a nice, large shower cap (for those of us with big heads and/or lots of thick, long hair; or, in my case, both), which I had trouble finding locally in stores. The lacy elastic band keeps my hair snugly in place and dry, which is really its only job in life.  One thing to note: the blue dot pattern cap is not as opaque as pictured. It appears to be white, but it's actually somewhat translucent with the blue dots. Almost like a frosty shower curtain liner. That's not an issue for me, but
Definitely better than the disposable ones. Fitted band for a secure leak free wear.

reviews.t: Works just like a shower cap!  (wow!)
reviews.x: I ordered this cap because I was looking for something cheap, yet more durable than the disposable shower caps.  And that is exactly what it is.  I have used it maybe 8 times now, which I know isn't a lot, but it is still as if it were brand new.  Seems like it will last me for some time, as long as I treat it properly and don't take a scissors to it or anything!  ;-)

This is definitely not extra large.  It's just your standard, run-of-the-mill shower cap that can be purchased at any local pharmacy or grocery store, and frankly, it's not even the best of those that I've tried. The elastic is loose and lets in a good bit of moisture (and I have a pretty big head, so the fact that it's loose on me should say something).  If you are looking for a truly extra large shower cap, look for the simply elegant extra large shower cap with a drawstring sold on Amazon as
It broke after six weeks！very upset with it ！don't waste your money

This is the only shower cap you'll ever need.  Yes, you can get fancier, and yes, you can pay a whole lot more.  The size is ample, the tightness is perfect, and there's lace around the edge.  Love it!
All in all, this shower cap will serve it's purpose. My pictures show how much hair needed to be covered. And I have no complaints. This item did it's job.
I have long hair, there is enough room and the elastic is snug enough not to let in water.  Would purchase again.
Very affordable, and works extremely well at keeping your hair dry.... the only thing a shower cap is required to do!

This is a normal size shower cap. It is very nice, but it is no bigger than the three previous caps that I bought at Walmart and Target.  I don't have a big hairdo, but my head itself is larger than most shower caps are for.  It obviously fits, but it is too snug on my head than the ones I used to get years ago.

reviews.t: Great for home or travel use
reviews.x: Many hotesl no longer provide a shower cap in their bathrooms, do having these is a real necessity for me.  They are snug around the face and full enough that hair is not pushed out of its styling.  They are made well and offered at a very reasonable cost.

reviews.t: By far the best shower cap out there!
reviews.x: I have tried many shower caps before and it was very hard for me to find something good for my head. I have long hair coming down to my mid back and keeping it dry is really important to me to prevent frizz and oiliness. Most shower caps made in China were probably also to be sold on the Asian market, because anything made for Asians is too small for the rest of the world. None of them would cover my whole head and the water would always wet my hair. Finding this cap was literally a lifesaver. E

I'm very disappointed in this shower cap, it's itchy and uncomfortable and quite frankly doesn't even keep my hair dry.  My entire hairline is wet when I use this shower cap.  I wish I could return this item, however it is not eligible for return - would be nice if that were disclosed prior to purchase.  I would not recommend this item at all and I am very surprised by the positive reviews.

Exactly what I needed. It looks cute with the polka dots and a lace ribbon trim around the head opening. Stays on in the shower - fits my head just fine. It's a nice thin vinyl (not the heavy-duty one), but doesn't leak. I got it a little stained with hair dye - but it washed off just fine (just do it quickly).  Very happy with it - it's exactly what I needed.

I saw many reviews saying this shower cap was too small and the lace was itchy. I have an average side head and the cap fits my head perfectly. I wore it all night and was still on when I woke up the next morning. I use mine to apply coconut oil to my hair and let it sit throughout the night, and there was no 'leakage' of the oil on my pillow or sheets when I woke up the next morning.  As for the lace, I can see where people can say that it was itchy...that is if you have the lace tucked under t
This was meant for kid. It was not a L or XL as described. IT was a big disappointment. I will never buy anything from this site again.
The product arrived on time. It is as described in the website. The product is ideal for showers. The material is durable and does not wear out easily when used. I like it !
Wtf? i think i had boght a shower cap...

I'm back ordering my second one of these, so I figured it was time to write a review! I have a bigger than average head and very long hair and it all fits nicely in this shower cap. Elastic could be a little tighter to ensure the edges of my hair stayed dry, but it does a decent job and isn't exceptionally itchy or uncomfortable at the edge. I'm ordering a second because the elastic in the first has gotten gross and I'm wary of washing it. It does the job, though, and for the price it's the best

reviews.t: Hot rollers? Pop this right on over them..
reviews.x: I got this for dying my hair and keeping my straightened hair from getting wet when I shower. It is huge. Definitely would be able to fit it over a head full of hot rollers. And it has a lace trim around it? Really looks old ladyish so I don't let my fiancé see me wearing it 😂 But it does its job and there's room to spare. I guess better too big than too little. And the elastic stays in place pretty well and doesn't give you an ugly mark from wearing it too long..

reviews.t: Ribbon that frames the cap soaks up water and gets my hairline wet
reviews.x: I was glad I read the reviews from other buyers so I knew the item was clear with blue dots not white with blue dots.  I didn't care but it was nice to get an accurate description from someone, even if it was another buyer.  The product is good but not great.  The positives are that it is snug and stays in place.  The negative is that the ribbon that frames the cap soaks up water so my hair line gets wet.  The point is to keep my hair dry and this product does not really do that.  I have to put

Very small.  Does not have the "pouf" shown in the picture; fits about like a skull cap.  Really, how much more could it cost to make a shower cap that fits an adult woman who has some hair ? Very disappointed.
When I got the package, there was already a big cut on the package itself and it was taped back. The shower cap was also being cut open, can’t use it. :( can’t return it, it is a waste of money.

reviews.x: Caps fits great but after using I saw on the package that it contains chemicals known to the state of California to cause cancer and/or birth defects or other reproductive harm. Threw it out.
The cap was for my elderly mother, and it is perfect. It fits well and protects her hair from the shower. Plus, it is very pretty.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the cap keeps hair dry and fits snugly, working as intended.
Several reviewers say it is durable and better value than disposable caps.
Some reviewers report the size is not actually extra large and is too snug.
A few reviewers complain the elastic is loose or itchy and lets in moisture.
One reviewer reports the cap broke after six weeks.

qa.q: Will this shower cap fit my large head?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree on fit for large heads: some say it is not extra large and is snug on a big head [1][2], while others say it is a nice large cap for big heads [6] and ample in size [5].

claims.text: It is not extra large and is loose even on a big head [1], and it fits but is too snug on a larger head [2].
It is a nice, large shower cap for those with big heads [6], and the size is ample [5].

qa.q: Is the vinyl material durable enough for daily use?
qa.answer: Reviews describe the material as durable and not wearing out easily [1], and one user found it still like new after about 8 uses [6]. However, one reviewer notes it is a thin vinyl rather than heavy-duty [2], so opinions on durability differ.

claims.text: The material is durable and does not wear out easily when used.
After about 8 uses it is still as if it were brand new and seems like it will last some time.
It is a nice thin vinyl, not the heavy-duty one.

qa.q: Is the elastic band comfortable and not too tight?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree on comfort and tightness: some find the elastic snug and not uncomfortable [2][3], while others call it itchy and uncomfortable [4]. One reviewer also felt the elastic could be tighter [3].

claims.text: The elastic is snug enough and not exceptionally itchy or uncomfortable at the edge.
The cap is itchy and uncomfortable.
The elastic could be a little tighter.

qa.q: Does the vinyl smell like chemicals or plastic?
qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.q: Is it good value for the price?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree on value: some call it very affordable and reasonably priced [4][6], while one reviewer was disappointed and wished to return it [2].

claims.text: It is offered at a very reasonable cost.
One reviewer was very disappointed and wished they could return it.
